text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Jungle Pocket got 
injured, so I brought her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, you're exaggerating. This 
barely even hurts.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Back when I was in L/Roars, we'd still 
throw down even with injuries like this, 
ya know?"
choice_data_list: No, let's get some proper rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No need for that. This doesn't even count 
as an injury.
choice_data_list: いや、今はしっかり休もう
choice_data_list_en: No, let's get some proper rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, letting my body get rusty 
would be way worse. Let's do this—training 
time."
choice_data_list: We should leave nothing to chance.

As long as it doesn't make you push 
yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant future awaits her. Nothing can 
be allowed to go wrong, not even the 
slightest mishap.
choice_data_list: 無理をしない範囲でなら……
choice_data_list_en: We should take every possible precaution.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Just like my big bro.
choice_data_list: ケガが悪化するリスクは避けたいんだ
choice_data_list_en: I want to avoid the risk of your injury getting worse.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I enter a street race, Aniki 
always tells me: "Make sure you don't get 
hurt."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I definitely don't wanna make it 
worse.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Guess so. I'll take your word for it and 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Something like this is no 
big deal at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Guh—!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heheh, bring it on...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, I can totally keep going, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I put my mind to it, something like 
this is nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's dead serious...! If this goes on, it 
could easily lead to a severe injury.
choice_data_list:
Any more than this is absolutely out of 
the question!!

Any more than this is absolutely out of 
the question!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...! ...Why, you.
choice_data_list: これ以上は絶対にダメだ！！
これ以上は絶対にダメだよ！！

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "...Tch, fine, I got it. I'm going back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her injury worsening, Jungle Pocket 
spent the following days resting...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Heheh, how's that for ya?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right? A little scrape like this is 
nothin' to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket gently worked her body and 
smoothly overcame her injury.
